can you check in all history ?
Gemini response
Unfortunately, I cannot access the revision or version history of the Google Sheet.Why this isn't possible:
  • API Limitations: Automated tools and AI assistants can only read the current grid data and cell values within the spreadsheet; Google Sheets does not expose user audit trails, per-cell revision history, or version snapshots through this interface.
  • Privacy & Audit Logs: Detailed edit history by specific user accounts (like samibentaiba25@gmail.com) is only tracked internally by Google Sheets.
How you can check it yourself in Google Sheets:
  1. Cell Edit History (Cell-by-Cell):
    • Right-click any cell in Column P.
    • Select "Show edit history" (أظهر سجل التعديلات).
    • Use the arrows to see who changed that specific cell, what was changed, and the exact timestamp.
  2. Full Document Version History:
    • Go to File > Version history > See version history (or press Ctrl + Alt + Shift + H).
    • Look at the right sidebar to see versions grouped by date/time and color-coded by the user who made the edits.
